description: This Java source file defines the NoteResponse class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used in the backend to represent and return note data via the API. It includes fields for id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt, along with getters and setters for each. The class comments suggest it is part of the external API interface.

classes.name: NoteResponse
classes.description: A DTO representing a note returned by the API, containing note metadata such as id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt.
